title: Commit small, commit often
why_it_matters: Small commits make bugs easy to find and easy to undo.
explanation: One commit should do one thing, with a message that says what. git add -p lets you pick which chunks of changes go in, so unrelated edits do not get bundled together.
code:
git add -p
git commit -m "Add login form validation"
git push
try_it: Make two unrelated edits, then commit them as two separate commits.
